issue_context.title: Stack overflow exception thrown by `JsonSerializer.Deserialize` in a special case
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @dotnet/area-system-text-json, @gregsdennis See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
### Description Stack overflow exception is thrown by `JsonSerializer.Deserialize` for a special case object when .NET 8 uses code generated by previous .NET versions. ### Reproduction Steps a .NET 8 application ```cs using System.Text.Json; using Lib; JsonSerializer.Deserialize("{}", X.XSerializerContext.Default.X); ``` a .NET 6/7 (I only tested with these versions) library referenced by the application ```cs using System.Text.Json.Serialization; namespace Lib; public class XBase { } public partial class X : XBase { public Y? Z { get; set; } [JsonSerializable(typeof(X))] public partial class XSerializerContext : JsonSerializerContext { } } public class Y { public X? Q { get; set; } } ``` ### Expected behavior Stack overflow doesn't occur. ### Actual behavior Stack overflow occurs. ### Regression? _No response_ ### Known Workarounds _No response_ ### Configuration .NET 8: 8.0.100-preview.3.23178.7 ### Other information _No response_
Author: KubaZ2
Assignees: -
Labels: `area-System.Text.Json`
Milestone: -
As part of fixing this, we should ensure we have tests that exercise a good sampling of sources produced by all previous generator versions.

There's a regression suite, but it's fairly basic in the scenaria that it is covering:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/tree/main/src/libraries/System.Text.Json/tests/System.Text.Json.Tests/SourceGenRegressionTests
